prompt: In the anime style, a lively rooftop party unfolds under a starry sky. On the left, a girl with pink twin-tails stands holding a glowing sparkler. Next to her, a boy in a blue hoodie leans against the railing, looking at the city lights below. A small brown dog sits on the concrete floor near their feet, chewing on a rubber bone. In the center, a man in a red scarf hands a paper plate of sushi to a woman wearing large round glasses. She smiles while pointing at a distant skyscraper with her free hand. Behind them, a tall cactus in a terracotta pot stands silently beside a stack of empty soda cans. To the right, an old man with a white beard plays an acoustic guitar for a captivated audience. A cat with black and white fur sleeps peacefully on top of a wooden crate next to the musician. A teenager in a yellow cap dances energetically near a portable speaker that pulses with blue light. A girl in a green dress watches the dancer while sipping from a metal straw. Further back, a couple shares a quiet moment; the man in a leather jacket has his arm around the woman in a floral skirt. They are looking at each other affectionately. A drone hovers overhead, capturing the scene with its single red lens. A discarded pizza box lies open on the ground near the edge of the roof. There is no rain falling from the sky. There is no police presence or security guards visible anywhere.
